Input: `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main`, `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Supplementary` (one workbook per panel, 01-21)
Output: `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Source_Data.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(file.path(path_source, c("Main", "Supplementary")), pattern = "^Figure.*\\.xlsx$",
                    recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
panels <- tibble(file = files, panel = sub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(files))) %>%
  mutate(supplementary = grepl("^FigureS", panel),
         number = as.integer(sub("^FigureS?([0-9]+).*", "\\1", panel)),
         letter = sub("^FigureS?[0-9]+", "", panel)) %>%
  arrange(supplementary, number, letter)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(panels$panel), setequal(panels$panel, names(descriptions)))
nrow(panels)
```

##### Workbook: Contents sheet, then one sheet per panel (one per part for multi-part panels)
```{r}
wb <- createWorkbook()
header <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")
contents <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(panels))) {
  short <- sub("^Figure", "Fig", panels$panel[i])
  parts <- excel_sheets(panels$file[i])
  for (part in parts) {
    sheet <- if (length(parts) == 1) short else substr(paste(short, part), 1, 31)
    data <- read_xlsx(panels$file[i], sheet = part)
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet)
    writeData(wb, sheet, data, headerStyle = header)
    freezePane(wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
    contents[[sheet]] <- data.frame(
      Sheet = sheet,
      Figure = paste0(if (panels$supplementary[i]) "Supplementary Figure " else "Figure ", panels$number[i]),
      Panel = panels$letter[i],
      Part = if (length(parts) == 1) "" else part,
      Description = descriptions[[panels$panel[i]]])
  }
}

notes <- data.frame(Notes = c(
  "AOI: GeoMx area of illumination (DCC file name). Patients are coded Pt_01-Pt_14.",
  "Volcano plots: all genes tested (limma-voom); Labelled = gene labelled in the panel.",
  "GSEA and over-representation: gene sets with BH-adjusted p <= 0.05; Shown = gene set drawn in the panel."))

contents <- bind_rows(contents)
addWorksheet(wb, "Contents")
writeData(wb, "Contents", contents, headerStyle = header)
writeData(wb, "Contents", notes, startRow = nrow(contents) + 3, headerStyle = header)
setColWidths(wb, "Contents", cols = 1:5, widths = c(28, 24, 7, 24, 100))
freezePane(wb, "Contents", firstRow = TRUE)
worksheetOrder(wb) <- c(length(names(wb)), seq_len(length(names(wb)) - 1))

saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(path_source, "Source_Data.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
contents
```
